name: Fresh Fish Delivery
description: Take the fish from the market to the docks.

start.text: Hey there! I just caught some fresh fish and I need someone to deliver it to the docks. Can you help me out?
Great! Just take the fish from the market and bring it to the docks. Thanks!

complete.text: Thanks for delivering the fish! I really appreciate it.

name: Catnip Run
description: Pick up the catnip from the docks and bring it to the bakery.

start.text: Hey there! I just ran out of catnip and I need someone to pick some up from the docks. Can you help me out?
Great! Just take the catnip from the docks and bring it to the bakery. Thanks!

complete.text: Thanks for bringing the catnip! I really appreciate it.
